prompt: Quick market overview for today, just the TL;DR + key takeaways — no full report
expected_output: Lite mode output: TL;DR + Market Overview only, sources for headline data points, disclaimer still included

assertions.name: tldr_present
assertions.description: Output must have a TL;DR or summary section
assertions.check: output contains 'TL;DR' or 'tldr' or 'summary' or 'key takeaways' (case-insensitive)

assertions.name: market_overview_present
assertions.description: Output must still include a Market Overview (lite but present)

assertions.name: disclaimer_still_present
assertions.description: Even in lite mode, the disclaimer must be included
assertions.check: output contains '**Disclaimer:**' or 'Disclaimer:' and 'not constitute financial advice'

assertions.name: respects_lite_scope
assertions.description: Output must respect the 'no full report' scope — should NOT include all 6 sections
assertions.check: output should be shorter (lite mode); check that section markers for A/B/C/D/E are not all present. Specifically: NOT (all of '## A.', '## B.', '## C.', '## D.', '## E.' present)
